question: Compare Kevin Durant in 2011-12 through 2013-14 with James Harden in 2016-17 through 2018-19 on regular-season shooting efficiency. Compute TS% from summed points, field-goal attempts and free-throw attempts, using 0.44 for free throws. Also compare each player with the contemporaneous league: weight each season's player-minus-league TS difference by that player's FGA + 0.44 * FTA. Which player leads each efficiency measure? Limit the conclusion to these windows; do not infer overall scoring or player superiority.

findings.task: Investigate Kevin Durant's regular-season scoring volume, shooting percentages, and true shooting efficiency in 2011-12 through 2013-14, alongside James Harden's corresponding metrics in 2016-17 through 2018-19.
findings.notes_status: Working notes only; Lead content checks and final report facts use verified scoped evidence.
findings.findings:
- Kevin Durant played 228 regular-season games across 2011-12 through 2013-14, averaging 38.5 minutes and 29.49 points per game (`ev_004f278c1da846599ee2`).
- Durant's shooting splits across the 2011-12 through 2013-14 regular seasons were 50.32% FG, 39.69% on 5.13 three-point attempts per game, and 88.18% FT (`ev_004f278c1da846599ee2`).
- Durant achieved an effective field goal percentage (eFG%) of 55.57% and a true shooting percentage (TS%) of 63.15% in his 2011-12 through 2013-14 regular-season window (`ev_004f278c1da846599ee2`).
- James Harden played 231 regular-season games across 2016-17 through 2018-19, averaging 36.2 minutes and 31.88 points per game (`ev_8f40930e07a8b4a37331`).
- Harden's shooting splits across the 2016-17 through 2018-19 regular seasons were 44.33% FG, 36.11% on 10.85 three-point attempts per game, and 86.13% FT (`ev_8f40930e07a8b4a37331`).
- Harden achieved an effective field goal percentage (eFG%) of 53.58% and a true shooting percentage (TS%) of 61.62% in his 2016-17 through 2018-19 regular-season window (`ev_8f40930e07a8b4a37331`).
- Counts cover returned NBA regular-season participation only and do not include postseason games or hypothetical full-season projections (`ev_54ea4a45c9c1022f0763`, `ev_fd2b54862dc9a7e2178c`).

findings.task: Examine contemporaneous league-wide scoring and shooting efficiency benchmarks for the 2011-12 through 2013-14 and 2016-17 through 2018-19 periods.
findings.notes_status: Working notes only; Lead content checks and final report facts use verified scoped evidence.
findings.findings:
* For Kevin Durant across the 2011-12 through 2013-14 regular seasons, contemporaneous league true shooting percentages were 52.71% (2011-12), 53.46% (2012-13), and 54.09% (2013-14) [ev_8bc42d6bd614c9235391].
* Kevin Durant's true shooting percentages across the same span were 60.96% (2011-12), 64.66% (2012-13), and 63.49% (2013-14), yielding relative true shooting marks of +8.25%, +11.20%, and +9.40% percentage points [ev_8bc42d6bd614c9235391].
* Durant's shot-opportunity-weighted relative true shooting over his 3-season window was +9.67 percentage points across 5,322.6 total shooting opportunities [ev_8bc42d6bd614c9235391].
* For James Harden across the 2016-17 through 2018-19 regular seasons, contemporaneous league true shooting percentages were 55.24% (2016-17), 55.62% (2017-18), and 55.96% (2018-19) [ev_94ebe2939b0ed6a9e88e].
* James Harden's true shooting percentages across the same span were 61.33% (2016-17), 61.93% (2017-18), and 61.62% (2018-19), yielding relative true shooting marks of +6.10%, +6.32%, and +5.66 percentage points [ev_94ebe2939b0ed6a9e88e].
* Harden's shot-opportunity-weighted relative true shooting over his 3-season window was +6.00 percentage points across 5,976.04 total shooting opportunities [ev_94ebe2939b0ed6a9e88e].
* League scoring efficiency rose between the two periods, with league true shooting increasing from a range of 52.71%-54.09% in Durant's window to 55.24%-55.96% in Harden's window [ev_8bc42d6bd614c9235391, ev_94ebe2939b0ed6a9e88e].
* Coverage is 100% for all specified player-seasons with no interpolated data or missing baseline seasons [ev_8bc42d6bd614c9235391, ev_94ebe2939b0ed6a9e88e].
